readout.test: Ad A vs Ad B, AC Repair ad group, 2026-07-22 to 2026-10-19
readout.why_observational: No Google Ads experiments exist in the account (0 rows). The two ads rotate under maximize conversions with ad rotation not set (Google default: optimise), so Google sends more auctions to the ad it predicts will do better. Ad A got 55% of impressions.
what_differs: One reworded headline: Ad A "1,200+ Five-Star Reviews", Ad B "Rated 4.9 by 1,200 Customers"
Ad B pins "AC Repair in Riverton" to headline 1; Ad A pins nothing
readout.isolation: 2 differences. The result belongs to the bundle (the pin plus the reworded review headline), not to either change alone.

guardrail_cost_per_conversion.note: Within the 20% limit. Ad B's cheaper clicks offset its lower conversion rate.

checks.same_dates: Both ads served on all 90 days.
checks.sample_ratio: Not tested: the split is set by Google's optimised rotation, not by a planned 50/50.
checks.conversion_counting: 5 counted conversion actions; 1 counts many per click. Several can fire on one click, so the conversion-rate test is approximate.
checks.conversion_lag: The window ends on 2026-10-19, within 7 days of the run. Both ads lag alike, so the comparison holds; totals will still rise a little.

segments.reported: tested (both ads have at least 30 clicks)

verdict.reason: Ad A's click-through rate is higher by 12.4% relative (p = 0.0268), and it also leads on conversions per impression (p = 0.0466). Conversion rate per click is not significantly different (p = 0.2932). It is a leaning winner, not a winner, because the comparison is observational and the ads differ in 2 ways.
verdict.worth_per_month: About 21 more clicks and 10 more conversions a month if Ad B's impressions (about 3560 a month) performed at Ad A's rates. Estimate: it assumes the gap is caused by the ad.
verdict.next: Pause Ad B (do this in Google Ads), then test a single change to Ad A (the design below). Avoid pinning headline 1 in new ads until a controlled test says otherwise.

ad_a_lines_about_duct_cleaning_or_air_qu: Dusty vents? Add whole-home duct cleaning to any visit and breathe cleaner air all year.
Allergy season? Our indoor air quality check finds dust, mold and worn filters fast.
evidence.gap: Ad A spends 2 of its 4 descriptions and 2 of its 13 headlines on duct cleaning and indoor air, while almost every visible click comes from searches about a broken or noisy AC.

design.hypothesis: If we replace Ad A's 2 duct-cleaning descriptions with two AC-repair descriptions, click-through rate will rise by about 30%, because 100% of visible clicks and 99% of visible impressions come from searches about AC repair, not duct cleaning. 30% is also the smallest lift this ad group's volume can detect within 8 weeks; a smaller real lift would read as inconclusive.
design.variant: Ad A with descriptions 1 and 2 replaced; every headline, the other two descriptions, the URL and the paths unchanged
design.single_change: the message of descriptions 1 and 2 (duct cleaning and indoor air → AC repair)

sizing.why: About 51 conversions per ad by the end, under 100, so conversion rate is a guardrail, not the primary metric. A 30% lift is the smallest that fits in 8 weeks at this volume.

design.design: A/B as a Google Ads ad variation experiment, 50/50 split (controlled). The user sets it up in Google Ads, scoped to Ad A, and enters the text change in ad_variation_change; an ad variation edits Ad A's text inside the experiment and doesn't use a separately created ad. The quicker option, the paused challenger in fixes_offered enabled beside Ad A, gives another observational readout.

rules.primary: click-through rate, at least +30% relative at 95% confidence
guardrails: cost per conversion no more than 20% worse
conversion rate per click no more than 15% worse

decision.winner_but_guardrail_broke: don't apply; check which searches the new copy attracted
decision.inconclusive_at_end: keep Ad A; record the detectable lift
decision.loser: keep Ad A; record that the duct-cleaning angle helps here

rules.end_date: fixed at 35 days after launch; no early stop except broken tracking or a disapproved ad

launch_checklist: write down the hypothesis, metrics, sample size and end date
pause Ad B first, so the experiment compares Ad A with its variation only
in Google Ads, create the ad variation scoped to Ad A, change only descriptions 1 and 2 (ad_variation_change), 50/50 split
check on day 1-2 that both arms record clicks and conversions
no budget, bid or keyword changes in the AC Repair campaign during the test
note promotions, heat waves or site outages
book the readout for the end date

before.criteria: click-through rate +30% at 95%; cost per conversion within 20%; conversion rate per click within 15%
